entities.name: Antón Reixa
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Antón Reixa is a Spanish poet, writer, musician, film and television director, and audiovisual producer. He is considered one of the leading figures of contemporary Galician culture and language, known for pioneering experimental poetry and rock music in the Galician language.
